# The Frozen Forge of Krakdhumvror (4208). Generated by "Claude files/tools/krakdhumvror_2026-11-11/gen.py".
# Country scope unless said.

DA_FF_remove_issue = {
	remove_country_modifier = DA_FF_issue_edge
	remove_country_modifier = DA_FF_issue_edge_deep
	remove_country_modifier = DA_FF_issue_shot
	remove_country_modifier = DA_FF_issue_shot_deep
	remove_country_modifier = DA_FF_issue_plate
	remove_country_modifier = DA_FF_issue_plate_deep
}

# the standing issue as a country modifier: the one chosen, at the strength of the draw; none while the forge is banked
DA_FF_sync = {
	DA_FF_remove_issue = yes
	clr_country_flag = DA_FF_issue_applied
	if = {
		limit = {
			DA_FF_forge_at_tier_1 = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_FF_draw_banked }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_FF_issue_edge }
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = DA_FF_draw_deep }
				add_country_modifier = { name = DA_FF_issue_edge_deep duration = -1 }
			}
			else = {
				add_country_modifier = { name = DA_FF_issue_edge duration = -1 }
			}
			set_country_flag = DA_FF_issue_applied
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_FF_issue_shot }
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = DA_FF_draw_deep }
				add_country_modifier = { name = DA_FF_issue_shot_deep duration = -1 }
			}
			else = {
				add_country_modifier = { name = DA_FF_issue_shot duration = -1 }
			}
			set_country_flag = DA_FF_issue_applied
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_FF_issue_plate }
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = DA_FF_draw_deep }
				add_country_modifier = { name = DA_FF_issue_plate_deep duration = -1 }
			}
			else = {
				add_country_modifier = { name = DA_FF_issue_plate duration = -1 }
			}
			set_country_flag = DA_FF_issue_applied
		}
	}
}

# the draw as a province modifier of the hold
DA_FF_sync_hold = {
	4208 = { remove_province_modifier = DA_FF_draw_deep_hold remove_province_modifier = DA_FF_draw_banked_hold }
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_FF_draw_deep }
		4208 = { add_permanent_province_modifier = { name = DA_FF_draw_deep_hold duration = -1 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_FF_draw_banked }
		4208 = { add_permanent_province_modifier = { name = DA_FF_draw_banked_hold duration = -1 } }
	}
}

DA_FF_set_draw_banked = {
	set_country_flag = DA_FF_draw_banked
	clr_country_flag = DA_FF_draw_deep
	add_country_modifier = { name = DA_FF_draw_changed duration = 365 }
	DA_FF_sync = yes
	DA_FF_sync_hold = yes
}

DA_FF_set_draw_steady = {
	clr_country_flag = DA_FF_draw_banked
	clr_country_flag = DA_FF_draw_deep
	add_country_modifier = { name = DA_FF_draw_changed duration = 365 }
	DA_FF_sync = yes
	DA_FF_sync_hold = yes
}

DA_FF_set_draw_deep = {
	set_country_flag = DA_FF_draw_deep
	clr_country_flag = DA_FF_draw_banked
	add_country_modifier = { name = DA_FF_draw_changed duration = 365 }
	DA_FF_sync = yes
	DA_FF_sync_hold = yes
}

# the Seekers of Perfection carried the remains off: the forge is banked until they come back
DA_FF_force_bank = {
	set_country_flag = DA_FF_draw_banked
	clr_country_flag = DA_FF_draw_deep
	DA_FF_sync = yes
	DA_FF_sync_hold = yes
}

		set_variable = { which = DA_Alloy_secondary_metal_1_C2 value = 22 }
		set_variable = { which = DA_Alloy_secondary_metal_2_C2 value = 18 }
		set_country_flag = DA_selected_primary_metal_C2
		set_country_flag = DA_selected_secondary_metal_1_C2
		set_country_flag = DA_selected_secondary_metal_2_C2
		set_country_flag = DA_Alloy_Enabled.C2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { DA_FF_slot_free_3 = yes }
		DA_initialize_alloy_variables = { DA_alloy_slot = C3 }
		change_variable = { which = DA_Alloy_strength_C3 value = 7 }
		change_variable = { which = DA_Alloy_Magic_Conductivity_C3 value = 5 }
		change_variable = { which = DA_Alloy_electrical_Conductivity_C3 value = 0 }
		set_variable = { which = DA_Cost_C3 value = 6 }
		set_variable = { which = DA_Alloy_primary_metal_C3 value = 19 }
		set_variable = { which = DA_Alloy_secondary_metal_1_C3 value = 22 }
		set_variable = { which = DA_Alloy_secondary_metal_2_C3 value = 18 }
		set_country_flag = DA_selected_primary_metal_C3
		set_country_flag = DA_selected_secondary_metal_1_C3
		set_country_flag = DA_selected_secondary_metal_2_C3
		set_country_flag = DA_Alloy_Enabled.C3
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { DA_FF_slot_free_4 = yes }
		DA_initialize_alloy_variables = { DA_alloy_slot = C4 }
		change_variable = { which = DA_Alloy_strength_C4 value = 7 }
		change_variable = { which = DA_Alloy_Magic_Conductivity_C4 value = 5 }
		change_variable = { which = DA_Alloy_electrical_Conductivity_C4 value = 0 }
		set_variable = { which = DA_Cost_C4 value = 6 }
		set_variable = { which = DA_Alloy_primary_metal_C4 value = 19 }
		set_variable = { which = DA_Alloy_secondary_metal_1_C4 value = 22 }
		set_variable = { which = DA_Alloy_secondary_metal_2_C4 value = 18 }
		set_country_flag = DA_selected_primary_metal_C4
		set_country_flag = DA_selected_secondary_metal_1_C4
		set_country_flag = DA_selected_secondary_metal_2_C4
		set_country_flag = DA_Alloy_Enabled.C4
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { DA_FF_slot_free_5 = yes }
		DA_initialize_alloy_variables = { DA_alloy_slot = C5 }
		change_variable = { which = DA_Alloy_strength_C5 value = 7 }
		change_variable = { which = DA_Alloy_Magic_Conductivity_C5 value = 5 }
		change_variable = { which = DA_Alloy_electrical_Conductivity_C5 value = 0 }
		set_variable = { which = DA_Cost_C5 value = 6 }
		set_variable = { which = DA_Alloy_primary_metal_C5 value = 19 }
		set_variable = { which = DA_Alloy_secondary_metal_1_C5 value = 22 }
		set_variable = { which = DA_Alloy_secondary_metal_2_C5 value = 18 }
		set_country_flag = DA_selected_primary_metal_C5
		set_country_flag = DA_selected_secondary_metal_1_C5
		set_country_flag = DA_selected_secondary_metal_2_C5
		set_country_flag = DA_Alloy_Enabled.C5
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { DA_FF_slot_free_6 = yes }
		DA_initialize_alloy_variables = { DA_alloy_slot = C6 }
		change_variable = { which = DA_Alloy_strength_C6 value = 7 }
		change_variable = { which = DA_Alloy_Magic_Conductivity_C6 value = 5 }
		change_variable = { which = DA_Alloy_electrical_Conductivity_C6 value = 0 }
		set_variable = { which = DA_Cost_C6 value = 6 }
		set_variable = { which = DA_Alloy_primary_metal_C6 value = 19 }
		set_variable = { which = DA_Alloy_secondary_metal_1_C6 value = 22 }
		set_variable = { which = DA_Alloy_secondary_metal_2_C6 value = 18 }
		set_country_flag = DA_selected_primary_metal_C6
		set_country_flag = DA_selected_secondary_metal_1_C6
		set_country_flag = DA_selected_secondary_metal_2_C6
		set_country_flag = DA_Alloy_Enabled.C6
	}
}

DA_FF_refreeze_dark_ice = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_FF_draw_deep }
		add_country_modifier = { name = DA_FF_troughs_refreezing duration = 365 }
	}
	else = {
		add_country_modifier = { name = DA_FF_troughs_refreezing duration = 730 }
	}
}

# every month, for the owner of Krakdhumvror and for a country that still carries an issue
DA_FF_monthly = {
	if = {
		limit = { DA_FF_old_save_leftovers = yes }
		DA_FF_convert_old_save = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { DA_FF_forge_at_tier_1 = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { DA_FF_giant_away = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_FF_draw_banked } }
			DA_FF_force_bank = yes
			country_event = { id = DA_Krakdhumvror_event.20 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { DA_FF_any_issue = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_FF_draw_banked } NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_FF_issue_applied } }
			DA_FF_sync = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { DA_FF_hold_out_of_step = yes }
			DA_FF_sync_hold = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				DA_FF_forge_at_tier_3 = yes
				NOT = { DA_FF_giant_away = yes }
				OR = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_FF_ruling_asked } had_country_flag = { flag = DA_FF_ruling_asked days = 60 } }    # asked once; again if the event could not fire
				4208 = { NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_FF_giant_kept } NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_FF_giant_buried } }
			}
			set_country_flag = DA_FF_ruling_asked
			country_event = { id = DA_Krakdhumvror_event.4 }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_FF_issue_applied }    # the hold is lost: the issue lapses, the choice is kept
		DA_FF_remove_issue = yes
		clr_country_flag = DA_FF_issue_applied
	}
}

# every year at a Deep draw: the cold may reach the hold
DA_FF_yearly = {
	if = {
		limit = { DA_FF_forge_at_tier_2 = yes has_country_flag = DA_FF_draw_deep }
		random_list = {
			80 = { }
			10 = { country_event = { id = DA_Krakdhumvror_event.30 } }
			10 = { country_event = { id = DA_Krakdhumvror_event.31 } }
		}
	}
}

# a save from before the Frozen Forge: the forge found becomes the wonder, Ice-Steel Forge II and III become tiers I and II,
# Ice-Steel equipment (shock / fire) becomes the standing issue Edge / Shot. Runs from DA_FF_monthly until nothing is left.
DA_FF_convert_old_save = {
	4208 = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_province_flag = DA_Krakdhumvror_exp1 NOT = { has_great_project = { type = DA_Frozen_Forge } } }
			add_great_project = { type = DA_Frozen_Forge instant = yes }    # the tiers follow a month later
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_province_modifier = DA_Ice_steel_forge3 }
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_great_project = { type = DA_Frozen_Forge tier = 1 } } }
					add_great_project_tier = { type = DA_Frozen_Forge tier = 2 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_great_project = { type = DA_Frozen_Forge tier = 2 } } }
					add_great_project_tier = { type = DA_Frozen_Forge tier = 1 }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_province_modifier = DA_Ice_steel_forge2 }
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_great_project = { type = DA_Frozen_Forge tier = 1 } } }
					add_great_project_tier = { type = DA_Frozen_Forge tier = 1 }
				}
			}
			remove_province_modifier = DA_Ice_steel_forge1
			remove_province_modifier = DA_Ice_steel_forge2
			remove_province_modifier = DA_Ice_steel_forge3
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { has_country_modifier = DA_Ice_steel_equipment_shock1 has_country_modifier = DA_Ice_steel_equipment_shock2 } }
		remove_country_modifier = DA_Ice_steel_equipment_shock1
		remove_country_modifier = DA_Ice_steel_equipment_shock2
		if = { limit = { NOT = { DA_FF_any_issue = yes } } set_country_flag = DA_FF_issue_edge }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { has_country_modifier = DA_Ice_steel_equipment_fire1 has_country_modifier = DA_Ice_steel_equipment_fire2 } }
		remove_country_modifier = DA_Ice_steel_equipment_fire1
		remove_country_modifier = DA_Ice_steel_equipment_fire2
		if = { limit = { NOT = { DA_FF_any_issue = yes } } set_country_flag = DA_FF_issue_shot }
	}
}

# an Ice-Steel Techniques project that was running when the mod was updated ends on its old date (events .2 and .3)
DA_FF_legacy_catch_up_1 = {
	if = { limit = { has_estate_privilege = DA_RS_project_Ice_Steel_techniques1 } remove_estate_privilege = DA_RS_project_Ice_Steel_techniques1 }
	4208 = {
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_great_project = { type = DA_Frozen_Forge } } }
			add_great_project = { type = DA_Frozen_Forge instant = yes }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_great_project = { type = DA_Frozen_Forge tier = 1 } } }
			add_great_project_tier = { type = DA_Frozen_Forge tier = 1 }
		}
	}
}

DA_FF_legacy_catch_up_2 = {
	if = { limit = { has_estate_privilege = DA_RS_project_Ice_Steel_techniques2 } remove_estate_privilege = DA_RS_project_Ice_Steel_techniques2 }
	4208 = {
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_great_project = { type = DA_Frozen_Forge } } }
			add_great_project = { type = DA_Frozen_Forge instant = yes }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_great_project = { type = DA_Frozen_Forge tier = 1 } } }
			add_great_project_tier = { type = DA_Frozen_Forge tier = 2 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_great_project = { type = DA_Frozen_Forge tier = 2 } } }
			add_great_project_tier = { type = DA_Frozen_Forge tier = 1 }
		}
	}
}
